product.name: IntelliLoop
product.subtitle: The Evidence-Reconciled Active Software Twin
product.promise: Build a living evidence-backed twin of one software change and reconcile requirements, decisions, code observations and validations into cited impact and deterministic release truth.

sourceDecision.reason: No candidate application source has sufficient exact-file ownership/license and competition-policy clearance.

targetStack.validation: JSON Schema at HTTP boundaries plus authored domain validators

winningCore.name: Evidence-cited AI explanation with deterministic fallback

supporting.name: Evidence timeline and versioned knowledge lineage

postCompetition: live production twin and shadow traffic
autonomous patch, apply, commit, push or deploy
enterprise connectors, identity, governance and signed Passports
cutOrder: ENH-01 only if its fixed fixture path cannot pass

featureFlags.name: ai.externalCalls
featureFlags.purpose: Explicitly enable a configured external provider; never required.

featureFlags.name: codeMap.enabled
featureFlags.purpose: Use the bounded code map for the controlled demo repository.

activeTwin.confidenceMeaning: Extraction or relationship-match confidence only, never truth probability.
activeTwin.versioning: Nodes and relationships are append-oriented revisions. Corrections supersede; they do not rewrite historical evidence.

codeMap.parser: TypeScript compiler API for source structure; JSON parser for manifests
codeMap.fallback: If parsing fails or exceeds limits, import the controlled demo asset manifest as explicitly declared evidence and mark inferred edges unavailable.

reconcileCore.input: One mission-scoped immutable Twin revision plus a reconciliation rule-set version.
rules: Compare normalized claims sharing subject and predicate with overlapping applicability.
Emit CONFLICT for incompatible values unless an explicit valid SUPERSEDES edge resolves applicability.
Emit STALE when a bound source, snapshot, relationship, validation or rule version changes.
Emit MISSING for required evidence or validation absent from the exact current scope and snapshot.
Emit AMBIGUOUS when evidence cannot deterministically select an interpretation.
Emit IMPACT_GAP when an affected critical asset lacks required implementation or validation support.
Invalidate dependent answers, assessments and Passports; never silently mutate historical results.

persistence.owner: apps/api only; browser never opens SQLite directly
persistence.database: One local SQLite file outside registered repositories
persistence.migrationStrategy: Numbered forward-only transactional SQL migrations recorded in schema_migrations; startup fails safely on unknown newer schema; migrations are tested from empty and previous fixture versions.
persistence.identity: Stable UUIDs plus unique project/mission/source digest/revision constraints; all derived records carry rule and schema versions.
persistence.deletion: No hard delete in the competition flow; archive or supersede. Demo reset affects only the dedicated synthetic workspace.

rules: no raw absolute paths in ordinary responses

accessibility: Do not encode trust by color alone

aiAdapter.offlineFallback: Render the same finding/impact structures as DETERMINISTIC_EXPLANATION with citations.
aiAdapter.redaction: Redact secrets and private path prefixes before persistence and again before optional transfer; show the user the outbound pack preview.
aiAdapter.usage: Store provider/model/request identifiers, latency and returned token usage when present; cost is an estimate, never billing truth; never store credentials.

entryCriteria: evidence ingestion and redaction tests pass
Reconcile Core conflict and staleness tests pass
citation IDs and evidence-pack digest are stable
AI-off explanation completes the golden path
provider-neutral adapter and mocked structured-output tests pass
personalOpenAiCheckpoint.credentialInjection: Runtime-only environment variable or OS secret mechanism; never commit, persist or print it.

demo.workspace: Controlled synthetic TypeScript retail repository generated as an IntelliLoop-owned fixture during development.
demo.change: Expand cancellation eligibility from BEFORE_PICKING to after picking starts but before dispatch.
initialEvidence: Requirement v2 permits BEFORE_DISPATCH cancellation and requires inventory release, refund, fulfilment stop and notification.
Older ADR permits cancellation only BEFORE_PICKING and assigns inventory release differently.
Snapshot changes cancellation and refund paths but omits inventory-reservation and fulfilment changes.
Order-state and refund validations pass while post-picking inventory and fulfilment validation is missing.
Release note claims the change is ready.
goldenFlow: Open apparently green overview without treating the claim as readiness.
Import attributed evidence and create the Twin.
Map bounded code assets and tests.
Reconcile the requirement/ADR conflict, unsupported ready claim and impact gaps.
Ask if release is safe and receive facts, inferences, gaps and citations.
Show explainable impact through order, inventory, refund, fulfilment, notification and tests.
Add an explicit superseding decision plus missing implementation/validation evidence.
Generate a Passport identical to the assessment projection.
Optionally change a bound source and show STALE.
demo.dataPolicy: Synthetic only; no Nisum, client, employer, personal or production repository content.

readyWhen: no unresolved critical conflict or impact gap
readinessAndPassport.passport: Immutable persisted projection of one assessment containing scope, snapshot, rule version, evidence digest, status, obligations, blockers, findings, validations, citations and passport digest.
readinessAndPassport.staleness: Any dependency change retains history and marks affected assessments, answers and Passports STALE.

aiMasteryConcepts.boundedCompetitionForm: Offline deterministic versus optional advisory explanation comparison only.
Deterministic Reconcile Core; no automatic code or prompt mutation.
Attributed imported runtime-observation summaries; no continuous learning.
Fact/inference separation, request lineage, evidence-pack digest and validated citations.
Compare imported named advisory outputs; no orchestration.
Non-applying remediation preview only; autonomous repair remains post-competition.
Synthetic retail fixture and cited edge-case suggestions.
Minimal deterministic safety/readiness guardrails with hard repository and citation boundaries.
Versioned requirements, decisions, repository observations, validations and explanations in one Twin; text/JSON/code, not broad media.
Token, timeout, concurrency and estimated-cost controls only.
Append-oriented lineage, supersession, read-only temporal comparison and stale historical outputs.

defaults: no shell or arbitrary code execution
repositoryControls: capture before/after status in repository-safety tests
privacyControls: no raw prompts or response bodies in normal logs

testStrategy.releaseGate: Winning core and offline path must pass independently of all feature flags and any personal OpenAI configuration.

risks.risk: Competition or source-ownership policy remains unavailable.
risks.control: Source-independent build; direct copy remains false.
Nine non-cuttable capabilities, explicit cut order and disabled stretch flags.

risks.risk: Code mapping appears broader than proof.
risks.control: Static TypeScript-only limits, explicit fallback and honest labels.

risks.risk: Provider output is ungrounded or unavailable.
risks.control: Citation rejection and complete deterministic fallback.
Accessible list/path view is authoritative; visualization is a projection.

assumptions: Individual participation permits a locally developed prototype using synthetic data.
The demo machine supports Node 22 and a local SQLite native dependency.
The final detailed event submission rubric may arrive later without changing the product truth model.
A personal OpenAI configuration may be tested later but is not guaranteed.
nonBlockingUnknowns: Exact judging weights and submission packaging rules
Whether a live internet connection is available on demo day
Which optional OpenAI model is selected at the checkpoint
Whether the bounded code-map UI uses a graph library or authored SVG/list projection
Final third-party notice inventory after dependencies are installed

definitionOfReady.criterion: Competition product, wedge and 5-7 minute promise are frozen.
All nine winning-core capabilities have owners, boundaries and completion evidence inherited from R1.
All 18 feature families and all six authorized candidates are qualified.
Every candidate-feature record above 50 percent has a disposition.
Reuse is source-independent and no permission is inferred from maturity.
Stack, module ownership, persistence and migrations are frozen.
Twin vocabulary, deterministic reconciliation and AI authority boundaries are frozen.
Bounded code map is kept with limits, safety rules and fallback.
API families, UI routes, demo fixtures and golden flow are frozen.
Personal OpenAI checkpoint is fully specified and unexecuted.
Stretch features are off by default and cannot block the winning core.
Test pyramid, restart, negative-path, safety and offline release gates are frozen.
No candidate changed, no source was copied and no product source was created in R2.
No implementation backlog or executable coding prompt was generated.

nextGate.outputWhenAuthorized: Dependency-ordered development backlog and only then the first bounded implementation prompt.
